reviews.text: Second bottle I buy as this product soothes my skin and helps to cover the redness after I apply make up, make to sure to wait couples minutes or the efectivo with be undone.
reviews.zh: 買第二枝，因為呢個產品有助舒緩我嘅皮膚，仲可以幫我化妝後遮住泛紅，要記住等幾分鐘，否則效果就會被破壞。

reviews.text: There’s a slight chemical smell when you first apply, but it disappears. You have to work fast because it dries very quickly even though it’s a liquid. I think my makeup lasts longer with it. It feels slightly oily.
reviews.zh: 第一次搽嘅時候有少少化學味，但好快就散。雖然係液體，但要快手做，因為乾得好快。我覺得用咗之後妝容更加持久。感覺有少少油。

reviews.text: i would recommend for normal to dry skin types, the consistency is similar to other sunscreens, but leaves a stickier finish to the skin. works well under foundations with a thinner/runnier consistency, but not under heavier/thicker foundations.
reviews.zh: 我會推薦中性至乾性膚質嘅人用，質地同其他防曬差唔多，但搽完皮膚會比較黏笠。配薄身／水狀粉底用效果好好，但配厚重粉底就唔得。

reviews.text: I really wanted to like it but it didn’t work well with any of my foundations or cushions, it kept peeling and it did not tone me up, just made me look like squidward. :(
reviews.zh: 我好想鍾意佢，但同我所有粉底同氣墊都夾唔到，不斷甩皮，又唔會幫我提亮膚色，只係令我望落好似章魚哥。:(

reviews.text: After reading great reviews and with hopes that the base will help with the dullness, tried Hince for the very first time. Easy smooth application due to its watery texture. Skin looks brighter and doesn’t feel heavy even after applying liquid or cushion foundation! Purchased the light peach to apply a colored (green/lavender) loose powder from a different brand on top.
reviews.zh: 睇完好多好評，加上希望呢款底霜可以改善暗沉，第一次試 Hince。質地水潤，上妝輕鬆又順滑。就算之後再搽粉底液或者氣墊粉底，皮膚望落更明亮，而且唔覺重！買咗 light peach，再喺上面撲其他牌子嘅有色（綠色／淡紫）碎粉。

reviews.text: This product is my first time trying Hince. It’s so good for color correcting if skin is sallow and not bright. The finish is really soft and the formula is lightweight. It brightens up my skin and I don’t need to wear makeup. It also has spf for sun protection. One of the best products I found!
reviews.zh: 呢個係我第一次試 Hince。如果膚色暗沉唔夠亮，佢修色效果一流。妝感好柔，配方好輕。提亮咗我嘅膚色，連妝都唔使化。仲有防曬指數可以保護皮膚。係我搵到嘅最佳產品之一！

reviews.text: I love this product! I got the Muted Green as I have acne and pigmentation and it’s does wonder to tone down the redness throughout my face. Resulting in a better application and finishing look with foundation! The product is easy to apply, through I would recommend using a sponge, cushion puff, or brush since it might leave some white cast from the product on your hand!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個產品！我揀咗 Muted Green，因為我有暗瘡同色斑，佢真係有神效，可以全面減退我塊面嘅泛紅。之後再上粉底就更加貼、妝容更完美！產品易用，不過我會建議用美妝蛋、氣墊粉撲或者掃，因為用手可能會有少少泛白嘅情況！

reviews.text: Good at reducing redness in a natural way, light in texture and adheres well to the skin. I’ve had no issues using this with my sensitive skin. You just need a little bit so even though the bottle is small I think it’ll last a while. Small size means it’s also easy to take with you and the plastic packaging feels quite robust and able to be thrown around in your bag.
reviews.zh: 可以自然地減退泛紅，質地輕盈，貼膚度好好。我敏感肌用咗都冇問題。每次只需要少少，所以雖然支裝細細支，我覺得都用到好耐。細支裝方便攜帶，而且膠樽包裝感覺幾紮實，放入袋度周圍撞都冇問題。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
